'''Sanshur Flats''' was an industrial manufacturing [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Vlemoth Port/Legends|Vlemoth Port]]. Built by the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] industrialists who developed Vlemoth Port, Sanshur Flats was located along a massive, continent-dividing river, and contained numerous [[Factory/Legends|factories]]. Before and during the pan-[[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Sanshur Flats produced [[Missile/Legends|missiles]] for the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] and their [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank|''Hailfire''-class droid tanks]]. The IGBC built an [[InterGalactic Banking Clan gun platform/Legends|orbiting gun platform]] known as [[Vlemoth Station]] to defend its interests from a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] attack, though the installation was later grounded on the planet's surface and converted into an independent [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] and administration center, where it towered over the nearby Sanshur Flats.<ref name="FLT" />

After the Republic was [[Declaration of a New Order|reorganized]] into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Vlemoth Port's industry was nationalized by the new Empire, and Sanshur Flats' industrial facilities were sold off to independent [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]]. Over [[Time/Legends|time]], the Muuns quietly bought back control of the planet, and turned to renting out Sanshur Flats' numerous factories to multiple corporations for the manufacture of a variety of goods. The Muuns oversaw Vlemoth Port's planetary commerce from the upper floors of Vlemoth Station, collecting rent and taxes on trade coming in and out of Sanshur Flats. Strict protocols and harsh enforcement established by the planet's Muun owners made [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] a rarity in the city.<ref name="FLT" />

==Behind the scenes==
The city of Sanshur Flats was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in the [[roleplaying game]] adventure book ''[[Friends Like These]]'', published on [[December 8]], [[2016]] by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].<ref name="FLT" />
